note: Browser inspection (built-in browser, 2026-11-03 ~12:00-12:45 ET). Inspected: OH NV NY MA OR NM OK SD AK HI TN WI NE NH MD IL. Not inspected: AL KS ME WY VI GU MP. 'VERIFIED READY' = endpoint returned valid 2026 general-election candidate data with no votes yet. Nothing is VERIFIED LIVE because polls have not closed; adapters are unrun against real votes.

AK.detail: www.elections.alaska.gov/results/ returned 403 Forbidden to the browser pane. Not worked around.

HI.detail: General-election text files are placeholders ("Information will be posted at a later date"). The 2026 primary summary.txt (tab-delimited) was inspected and an adapter written to that format; the general file URL is unconfirmed, so the adapter needs HI_RESULTS_URL and ENABLE_HI=1.

IL.detail: CSV per office exists (Downloads/ElectionOperations/ElectionResults/ByOffice/69/…-2026GP.csv) but only for the March 2026 general primary; the 2026 general election is not listed yet. A format fetch timed out, so the CSV layout is unverified.

MD.detail: Unofficial results page exists at elections.maryland.gov/elections/2026/general_results/index.html; no CSV/JSON link found yet.

MA.detail: JSON search works and lists only a 2026-03-03 special election; the November general is not listed yet. Office and district IDs for the general are unknown until it appears. Same platform as NH (nh.electionstats.com).

NE.detail: Senate, Governor and 3 House districts with 0 votes.

NV.detail: Governor and 4 US House districts with candidates; county votes null. Manifest release sequence 5 generated 2026-10-28. No US Senate race on the 2026 ballot there. Cloudflare/Incapsula wrapper on the site: unattended server fetches not yet tested.

NH.detail: nh.electionstats.com search URL returned "Page not found" in the browser pane; the NH ElectionStats path was not confirmed.

NM.detail: Senate, 3 House districts and Governor with 0 votes and 0/2204 precincts. Site auto-updates about every 5 minutes.

NY.detail: ENR site (nyenr.elections.ny.gov) is server-rendered ASP.NET HTML; no JSON/CSV requests seen. Polls close 9 PM; page lists no contests yet, so contest pages could not be inspected.

OH.detail: 2026 Governor, US Senate and 15 US House districts returned with candidates and 0 votes. Also GetElectionSummaryCsv (CSV). Undocumented API; terms of use not checked.

OK.detail: results.okelections.us returned 403 Forbidden to the browser pane. Not worked around.

OR.detail: Same vendor platform as NM/SD/NE, but /resultsCSV.aspx is not available. Exports are ASP.NET postbacks (ResultsExport.aspx) and a test postback returned HTML, not a file.

SD.detail: Senate, at-large House and Governor with 0 votes, 0/671 precincts, source timestamp.

TN.detail: Real ENR dashboard is tnelectionresults.com (the .tn.gov host does not load). Shows "November 3, 2026 Election"; no JSON/CSV/export link found.

WI.detail: State commission publishes only post-canvass results (archive page shows 2026 primary, no election-night feed). Statewide election-night totals come from counties; no free state feed identified.

VI.detail: Governor totals copied from the official Territorial Summary PDF (report dated 11/03/2026 9:00 PM) into data/manual-results.json. A point-in-time snapshot, not a live feed; update the file when a newer report is posted.
